title: Super Green Falafel Pita Pockets
subtitle: with Herby Salad and Spiced Yoghurt
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 200C, fan-forced, for the pita pockets (see Make it faster). Finely chop the parsley leaves and stems. Coarsely chop the coriander, discarding the stems. Peel the zucchini into ribbons with a vegetable peeler.
Warm pita: Halve the pita to form 4 pockets, put in a single layer on an oven tray and cover with foil. Heat in the oven for 10 mins or until softened and warmed through.

Fry falafel and zucchini: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Fry the falafel, turning regularly, for 3-5 mins until golden. Remove from the pan. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in the pan over high heat and cook the zucchini, turning, for 2-3 mins until lightly charred. Remove the pan from the heat.
Make zucchini salad: Combine 3 tsp olive oil, 2 tsp white wine vinegar and 1 tsp honey in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the zucchini, parsley and coriander and toss to combine.

Serve up: Combine the yoghurt and half the kofta seasoning in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Spread the inside of the pita with the yoghurt dressing and fill with the zucchini salad and falafel. Serve with any remaining salad and enjoy!
Make it faster: Don't feel like turning on your oven? Halve the pita to form 4 pockets. Put on a plate, slightly overlapping, and microwave for 30 secs or until warmed through.
